title: Marin Mentions monitors that are not places
notes: Each entry is a monitor id in marin-mentions/config/monitors.yaml, in the Districts, Cities and towns or Communities group, that is deliberately not a jurisdiction, with the reason.

A monitor in the Districts, Cities and towns or Communities group must either carry a local:marin-mentions-monitor-id on a jurisdiction in output/jurisdictions.jsonld or be listed here. Facilities are in output/facilities.jsonld instead.
